scope: Public geolocation and image research only. No PARK_DATA_EDITOR, Git, registry, reservation, source-data edit or media import.
method: Official contact page only embeds a park-address Google search; no individual attraction coordinates. This park-level location was excluded from item coordinates.
Read the exact public OSM park boundary, then its limited geographic bounding box using documented read-only OSM API. No point was generated from a map illustration.
Matched nominal objects to the 57 local item names, preserving IDs and geometry metadata. No polygon centre, area average, generic park coordinate or arbitrary node was selected.

Read seven public OSM changesets to qualify provenance. Sources include local knowledge, survey, IGN aerial imagery and earlier official park maps. These are historical mapping records, not fresh 2026 ground measurements.
No geotagged current photo independently establishes these item coordinates. Ordinary park photos do not prove a GPS point.

importantGaps: Two different Tir à l’arc points; do not prefer one solely because it was edited later.
Two nearby Trampoline points; possible multiple apparatus or mapping duplication, unresolved.
Generic Pitchounes and Aventure locations cannot be copied onto every numbered course.
Named paintball fields, Caisse, Scène, Ejector, Cabanes and barefoot trail have explicit footprints but no representative point provided by the source.
New mechanical rides from 2025, including La Pomme, have no matching named point in the OSM dataset read.
Aggregated Parkings/Sanitaires/Aires de pique-nique cover multiple places; one point cannot stand for all of them.
